title: A New Restaurant in Town
text:
Maria read a review of a new restaurant in town. The reviewer said the food was delicious, but the service was slow. He gave the restaurant four stars out of five.

Maria decided to try the restaurant anyway. She wanted to order the pasta, which the reviewer described as the best dish on the menu. She also planned to ask the waiter for a table near the window.

questions.text: How many stars did the reviewer give the restaurant?
Which dish did the reviewer describe as the best on the menu?
Why did Maria decide to try the restaurant even though the review mentioned slow service?
options: She trusted the praise for the food more than the complaint about service
She wanted to write a bad review
She was angry with the waiter

questions.text: What can be inferred about the reviewer's opinion of the restaurant?
options: He thought the restaurant was perfect
He liked the food but not everything about the restaurant

vocabulary.definition: a written opinion about a product, place or service
very good to eat or drink
the way staff help customers in a restaurant or shop
not fast; taking a long time

paragraph_translations: Maria leu uma avaliação de um restaurante novo na cidade. O crítico disse que a comida era deliciosa, mas o atendimento era lento. Ele deu ao restaurante quatro estrelas em cinco.
Maria decidiu ir ao restaurante mesmo assim. Ela queria pedir a massa, que o crítico descreveu como o melhor prato do cardápio. Ela também planejava pedir ao garçom uma mesa perto da janela.
